candidate.answerReason: 706 days consists of 100 complete weeks and six additional days. Six days after Saturday is Friday.

methods.label: Remove complete weeks
methods.explanation:
Carlos is zero days old on his birthday, a Saturday. Every seven days brings the same weekday again. Since
\[
706=7\cdot100+6,
\]
he will be \(706\) days old after \(100\) complete weeks and six additional days. The complete weeks bring him to Saturday, and six more days bring him to Friday. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{Friday, choice C}}\).
methods.levelReason: The seven-day cycle is handled by elementary division with a remainder.

candidate.annotationRationale: The question asks for the meaning of a remainder in a repeating weekly cycle. Applications of division with remainders is the direct target; one-digit division supplies the calculation. The method keeps the birthday as day zero.

review.mathematicalCheck: With birth as day zero, 706 = 7·100+6 gives 100 complete weeks followed by six days. Counting six days forward from Saturday gives Friday.
